repairs.quote: Taliyah scatters loose stones in an area, Slowing enemies hit by 20% and dealing (60/105/150/195/240 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The stones detonate when enemies dash or are Knocked through them, Stunning for the remaining movement duration + 0.75 seconds and dealing (25/40/55/70/85 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. The stun's duration cannot exceed 2 seconds. Each enemy can only be stunned once per cast. Monsters are always stunned for the maximum duration. Stones beyond the first one deal 25% less damage. Max detonation damage: (62.5/100/137.5/175/212.5 + (75% Ability Power)) This ability deals 225% damage to monsters.
